page.layout: One printed page, title-page layout: a centred block of lines at the top, a large centred line in the middle, a dark rectangular ornament or device in the lower middle, and smaller lines below it. A frame border surrounds the text area. No margin notes.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and heavily overlaid with show-through from the reverse side, so almost no line can be read with certainty. The large, bold, centred line in the upper-middle is mirrored, which points to show-through, and I have not transcribed it. The top block of lines is in capitals and is not legible enough to copy. The dark rectangle in the lower middle looks like a printer's device or woodcut ornament, not text. The lines below it are too faint to read. A transcription of this title page needs a higher-resolution or better-lit scan, or the recto of the leaf to separate printed text from show-through.
